messages:
deploy-bot: [AUTOMATED] Canary traffic for release `v3.7.2` -> observed p95 latency spike > 2x baseline for the last 3m. Suggest: HOLD rollout and evaluate. (slo:p95_latency, threshold:2.0)

mira ng: saw this on the dashboard, thanks for the flag. is this confined to us-west or global?

deploy-bot: Affected region: us-west-2 only. Error rate stable, CPU on serving nodes + KV cache miss rate increased.

alex chen: thanks. can we pin the canary back to `v3.7.1` while we investigate? if rollback, prefer manual to avoid churn.

sam ops: agree with manual pin. quick check — any schema or model change in 3.7.2 that would affect KV cache behavior?

jun park: 3.7.2 includes an LRU KV cache tweak + different kernel opt that changes padding strategy. I can open a short RCA but my immediate ask: keep canary traffic at 10% and stop further promotion.

mira ng: hold promo, yes. sam, can you draft the minimal rollback steps and comms for customers on Dedicated? we should not send wide comms yet.

sam ops: copying steps here:
```
# manual pin rollback (canary only)
redwoodctl rollout pin --region=us-west-2 --target-version=v3.7.1 --route=canary
redwoodctl scale --pool canary --replicas=3
# monitor p95 and KV hitrate for 10m
```
I'll run if we decide.

alex chen: good. release-manager-bot, do we have a change-window constraint for manual action? this is inside our 02:00-05:00 UTC change window.

release-manager-bot: Reminder: Change window: 02:00-05:00 UTC. This event is within the window; manual rollback requires at least one engineer + oncall signoff.

mira ng: jun, can you triage whether the LRU tweak is causing the miss spike? if so, a revert patch to revert that specific flag might be faster than rollback.

jun park: starting triage now. initial quick test points to suboptimal prefix eviction for long conversations — KV miss rate up ~40% on canary nodes. I can revert the flag and build a debug image in ~30m.

alex chen: ok timeline sounds good. if jun can produce a patch within 45m, prefer patch+retest over pin rollback. otherwise sam, proceed with manual pin.

sam ops: standing by. if we pin, I'll also update the internal release notes and notify any Dedicated customers in affected region with a short note.

mira ng: leave a short message in #customer-ops only if we actually execute pin. don't alert wider until we confirm impact.

deploy-bot: Canary hold enforced. Promotion blocked by safety-checkpoint: latency_regression_detected.

jun park: debug image ready in 28m, running perf harness now. will post results.

alex chen: thanks. once we have results, decide rollback vs patch. keep posts short here to reduce noise. :thumbsup:
